description.en-US: How this method is referred to everywhere else: momo, vietqr, mpos. Immutable, because orders already taken record it and a rename would detach them from the method they were paid by.

Which gateway adapter carries out a payment through this method. Separate from code so that two methods can be served by one adapter — a second MoMo merchant account, say — without either of them having to be named after the adapter.

The single currency this method settles in, when it settles in only one. Null means it imposes no restriction of its own. A reference into Essential's currency master, held as a plain id rather than an edge, because a foreign key across a module boundary would make this module's schema depend on Essential's table.
Smallest amount the gateway will accept. Held as data because each gateway sets its own floor and they change by contract, not by release.
Largest amount the gateway will accept.
Whether new payments may be taken through this method. Orders already taken through it stay readable when it is switched off, which is why this is not archiving.

Non-secret, per-method settings the adapter reads, such as a terminal group or a merchant sub-account. Credentials never live here: they come from configuration through the secret-file convention, because this table is readable through the API.
